newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas says gets new control system.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas says gets new control system.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd said on Tuesday it has implemented a new computerised reservation and airport departure control system, based on British Airways Plc's BABS system, replacing two previous systems.

The new reservation/airport despatch system is called QUBE, which replaces QANTAM and TAARSAN systems. Both of these systems have been used for many years by the previous Qantas, international, and Australian, domestic, airlines, Qantas said.
Qantas is 25 percent owned by British Airways.
